description: This stacked horizontal bar chart from the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision" compares two methods, labeled "Ours" and "Standard," by showing the percentage composition of three categories: "Context" (blue), "Generated Response" (orange), and "Other" (green). The horizontal axis represents the percentage value, ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick marks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100, and the vertical axis lists the two methods. For the "Ours" method, the blue "Context" segment is 60.6%, the orange "Generated Response" segment is 7.7%, and the green "Other" segment is 7.7%. For the "Standard" method, the blue "Context" segment is 23.6%, the orange "Generated Response" segment is 51.1%, and the green "Other" segment is 25.3%. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order shown in the legend, with "Ours" above "Standard." The chart visually emphasizes the "Generated Response" component for "Standard" and the "Context" component for "Ours."
